notes: Paper recasts the ORGAN Phase 1a axion-photon limit (|g_agamma| <= 3e-12 GeV^-1 over 63.2-67.1 ueV, published previously in Quiskamp et al. 2022) into NEW limits on dark photon kinetic mixing, scalar/dilaton coupling g_phi-gamma-gamma, and QEMD coupling g_aAB. The headline new result is the dark photon limit (most sensitive to date between 63.2 and 65.1 ueV), so DarkPhoton is chosen over the pre-analysis AxionPhoton hint (the axion limit itself is not new here). No numerical table is provided; data_points were computed from Eq.(7): chi = g_agamma*B0/(m_gamma' |cos theta|) with B0 = 11.5 T (= 2246.5 eV^2 in natural units), g_agamma = 3e-12 GeV^-1, and fixed-polarisation |cos theta| = sqrt(0.03), giving chi ~ 6e-13, consistent with Fig. 1. Random-polarisation limits would be ~3.3x stronger (chi ~ 1.8e-13). Scalar (g_phi-gamma-gamma ~ 4e-8 GeV^-1 level, weaker than CAST) and gaAB limits also presented, with projections for future ORGAN phases shown only as dashed lines.
